title: Those
summary: THOSE, pronoun s as z. plural of that; as those men; those temples. When those and these are used in reference to two things or collections of things, those refers to the first mentioned, as these doe

inlines.v: THOSE, pronoun s as z. plural of that; as those men; those temples. When those and these are used in reference to two things or collections of things, those refers to the first mentioned, as these does to the last mentioned. [See These, and the example there given.]
